name: live_status_capturing
notes: Capturing: game.live counters, the parts and the LIVE job.

name: live_game_capturing
notes: Live with stats: status ready, has_analysis true, has_video false, live.state capturing.

name: live_job_running
notes: The LIVE job during the game: kind live, stage gpu_processing.

name: live_jobs_list
notes: The game's jobs: the LIVE job.

name: live_games_list
notes: The list with a live game.

name: err_409_job_while_live
notes: No other analysis starts while the game is live.
error_message: This game is live: its film is being analysed as it arrives.

name: err_409_upload_while_live
notes: The film cannot be replaced while the game is live.
error_message: This game is live: its film is being analysed as it arrives.

name: live_finish
notes: No more film: state finishing, end_reason finished.

name: live_finish_again
notes: Can be repeated.

name: err_409_live_ended_segment
notes: Once the game no longer takes film: 409 LIVE_ENDED.
error_message: This live game is being finished.

name: live_status_ended
notes: Ended: state ended, end_reason finished, every part done.

name: live_game_ended
notes: After the end: a normal game that keeps its live record (has_tracking true; has_video true when the server could join the film).

name: live_job_succeeded
notes: The LIVE job after the game.

name: err_409_live_start_ended
notes: A game whose live stream has ended cannot go live again.
error_message: This game's live stream has ended.

name: err_409_live_ended_segment_after_end
notes: After the end: 409 LIVE_ENDED.
error_message: This live game has ended.

name: openapi_live
notes: The API description of a server with live games.

name: live_job_cancel
notes: Cancel on the LIVE job stops the live analysis.

name: live_status_cancelled
notes: After the cancel: state ended.
